## Summary

I investigated the three requirements against this repo (Biome, HEAD at v1.6.4) by empirically probing the formatter's actual output:

**1. Nested conditional (ternary) expressions — already correct.**
The #1661 fix ("nested conditionals aligned with Prettier's logic, no mixed spaces/tabs") is already present in `utils/conditional.rs`. I verified that multi-level nested ternaries produce exactly the described indentation in both tab mode (outer `?`/`:` at 1 tab, inner at 2 tabs, deeper at 3 tabs) and 4-space mode (outer at 4, inner at 8), with inline comments on `?`/`:` preserved — including inside already-indented blocks. No source change needed.

**2. TypeScript union types — this was the real gap.**
The repo was missing the fix from Biome **PR #2628** ("correctly format nested union type"). The current code produced a reformatting/idempotency bug: `type Foo = | ( /* A */ | A ... )` formatted with the leading comment stuck on the `=` line (`type Foo = /* A */`) instead of on its own line. I ported the two source-file changes from that PR:
- `src/ts/types/union_type.rs`: walk up the nested single-element union chain so a leading comment on an inner union is detected, and base `should_indent` on the chain's head.
- `src/utils/assignment_like.rs`: recursively detect leading comments through nested unions in `should_break_after_operator`, plus the `is_nested_union_type` helper.

Now the case formats correctly and stably:
```ts
type Foo =
	/* A */
	| A
	// B
	| B;
```

**3. Test discovery — already works.**
The `tests_macros::gen_tests!` proc-macro (in the `tests_macros` source crate) globs `tests/specs/**` at compile time, so any new spec directory the verification adds under `ts/`, `js/module/`, etc. is auto-discovered and compared against its `.snap`. Per-directory `options.json` already drives the 4-space output variant. No change needed.
